book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Papap am Iesu la tale kan naganming ira a
Urie, tubiat a iriro paga, Iesu la unama na nap iang provins Galili. Tale gat naong meba amung gat na provins Iudaia. Memani teip mila kakanim onim Iudaia la namo menamung ga aving.
Tie, na irie tara, la o sabat maiong Iudaiap la muior kagarat. Uriro la o sabat la meivo la o aganuliap me luguan o ifif.
Are ratmat ga papap am Iesu la megama aime, “Ei, onolaing uriro pianam ga nala na provins Iudaia, meba magimameng lop nuam o usingnualap ubiap la makosarnung.

Leba noba migana la naong meba ameira inamaniap, tale kan ume makosar ubiap na nap ila kagouri. Leba nama makosarnang miriro pagap o turupnuabap, tie makosarnang la uakap meba magimameng teip ga magaulap.”
Memani, papap am gat la tale kan naganmeng gare ro Iesu irie Karisito. Are ratmat ga tiesmeng gare tiro.
Ugama Iesu maime, “Tara ruang la tale ka betong titot. Pa puoming it meba mila na provins Iudaia.
Teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam la tale kan puomeng meba nekaromela ga mimi. Pa nekaromela ga turuo. Memani, tume ties me tavukup maiam mila kiram la mime makosar.
Mimi kan le mila ga ogimaming la o aganuliap. Pa turuo la tala kan tula na uriro la o aganuliap. Tara ruang ila muri la tale ka betong.”
Tiesong gare tiro mai papap am ga man uanula ka na provins Galili.
Iesu la ula ogimaong la o aganuliap a luguan o ifif.
Pa papap am Iesu la melar meba ogimameng la o aganuliap, tubiat irie gat la ula. Tale kan ula betong la uakap na pianam. Karuk. Man unum it ga man ula tigit.
Teip mila kakanim onim Iudaia la man aisinmeng na uriro la o aganuliap ga megama, “Iriro migana lagum la unama?”
Ga teip ga magaulap la mitara tiesmeng papot aime. Mirie la megama, “Irie migana ila mumuri.” Pa mirie la megama, “Karuk, ume mavana teip ga magaulap.”
Pa merau me Iudaiap mila uke ga karuk kan a noba migana le aramang ties ba aime la uakap.
Tie, kabirana o uriro la o aganuliap, ula Iesu betong na luguan o lotu ga baisong mai teip ga magaulap.
Teip mila kakanim onim Iudaia la turupmaiaba kirat ga megama, “Are mani ga amaning iriro migana uriro agat? Abit ara irie la tale kan ula na usingnualap.”
Iesu la upulo ties gare ro, “Uriro ties la tuaramo, la tale tung kan. Karuk. Ang Morowa, irie la tosagaong ga muruo.
Leba migana ba o magabun ba la namo oauluo ties ang Morowa, eba aera muana o uriro ties la tuaramo. Eba oera migat, uriro ties la maio aun Morowa, o atabo tuaramot na agat tung it.
Migana la okosarong ties o agat kan ang, la namo oala bonim ula kakanu. Pa migana la namo aving bonim ula kanu me aun iriro la asagaong ga muo, irie migana ila puvuvui, ga karuk kan o kiribas ba ang.
Tinan Moses la ualo maimai miun. Pa karuk kan a migana ba kabirana mi la ouluan maimai. Pa memani ga miga tominamung ga taving?”
Teip ga magaulap la mepulo ties ang ga megama, “Non muranama ila kire la ut ira nuo. Aga la namo noanamung ga naving?”
Upulo Iesu ties maiong ga ugama, “Okosartung non ubi na la o lotu ga amumurirarung non migana, pa mimi ganam la agatming papot.
Moses la uala tavuk o kasau miun. Migat Iriro tavuk la tale mavuo aun Moses. Mavuo maun tatimup. Pa mime makasau tatak lop na la o aganuliap gat.
Miga omiuluo maset maimai ang Moses la mime ogirip papak a kulot na la o lotu. Tie, na la o agnuliap la mamurirarung neip a non migana, pa memani ga papamnam dalap mi me rulam?
Baraba mavuvuoming it pagap ma irap mi. Agatming ka maset ga mavuvuoming pagap ganam la makosartung a tavuk ila puvuvui!”
“Iriro migana irie Karisito?”
Pa non teip ga magaulap onim Ierusalem la megama, “Iriro i migana la namo menamung ga aving.
Pa agimaming! Man tiesong la uakap, ga tale kan maiaramo ties ba aime. Atabo migat teip mila uke la amit, irie Karisito?
Pa obit maset pianam ang iriro migana. Pa tara leba betang Karisito, karuk kan a noba migana leba oera pianam ang.”

Iesu la man uaramo ties mai inamaniap na luguan o lotu. Ga marikong maranit gare ro, “Eva, tomit ara ga omit gat pianam tung! Pa tale kan muruo un agat tung kan. Mamo la tosagaong ga muruo. Tavuk ang la migat a. Pa tale amit.
Pa turuo la arit. Muana la tunama ga irie ga tosagaong ga muruo.”
Iesu la uaramo uriro ties, are ratmat ga namo avismeng teip mila uke. Pa tara ang o nuvarap la tale ka betong. Are ratmat ga karuk kan a migana ba la uat a kilan a ga abung na luguan o arubu. Karuk.

Pa papot ma teip ga magaulap kabirana ma la naganmeng ira ga megama, “Tara leba betang Karisito, atabo eba makosarang papot ma kagup onim na panbinim ga eba makurupmeling kagup onim na panbinim la makosarong iriro migana?”
Masagameng non inamaniap mila maiario kier meba umaiaring a Iesu

Urie, Parasaiop la meptam inamaniap la man maiaramam non ara non ara tiesiap me Iesu. Are ratmat ga miridaip mila kakanim ga Parasaiop la masagameng non teip la maiario kier meba umaiaring a Iesu ga avismeng.
Tie, ugama Iesu, “Tatak it tara la tunama ga mimi, ga eba ina tala ai irie la tosagaong ga muruo togo.
Ga eba man toisinming pa eba tale togimaming. Ga tale kan puoming meba mila na urie pianam leba tonang una.”

Teip mila uke onim Iudaia la man nemamarikmeng kabirana ma kan gare ro, “Tubiat eba ala lagum ga tala kan puobung meba abuving, a? Atabo eba ala mai garip buam na pianam maiong Grikip, ga eba man masingala Grikip o ties ang, a?
Ugama, ‘Eba man toisinming pa tala kan togimaming’, ga ugama gat, ‘Tala kan puoming meba mila na urie pianam la tunama una.’ Man muana o uriro ties?”

La lakorang o uriro la o aganuliap ma luguap o ifif la are la ula kakanu maset. Na urie la dusong Iesu ga marikong maranit me teip ga magaulap gare ro, “Leba noba migana la namo tapo o burunam, tie, muong toi ga tapo.
Memani, umir ang Morowa la igama, ‘Migana la naganong ira ruo, papot o burunam leba betieng na dalap a ga eba iriva ga ila. Uriro burunam la eba ialang ninimiap la iot atatan makin aun.’”

Iesu la tiesong me Muranama Ila Babai. Man migana la naganong ira, eba aala iriro Muranama Ila Babai. Pa Muranama Ila Babai la tale ka muo na irie tara. Memani, Iesu la tale ka oula bonim ula kakanu aun Morowa.
Teip ga magaulap la nekoratmeng ga narain garipien
Tie, tara la mepta teip ga magaulap la uaramo uriro ties, non kabirana ma la megama, “Migat ara, iriro migana la irie unuli, umir ang Morowa la tiesieng aime leba muong na kimanam.”
Mirie la megama, “Irie Karisito a.” Pa mirie la megama, “Karuk. Irie migana la avuoong Morowa, eba tale betang Galili. Karuk. Are mani ga eba betang Karisito Galili, a?”
Babam ula puaru la tiesieng ara, ‘Karisito la irie o butamat ang Devit, ga eba betang na pianam Betilem, uriro pianam tinan la unama Devit una.’
Are ratmat ga neratmeng teip ga magaulap me na narain garipien muana ira Iesu.
Mirie la nameng la namo avismeng, pa karuk kan a noba migana la uabua kilan ira meba uaring a.
Teip mila uke ume Israel la tale kan naganmeng ira Iesu
Tie, tubiat teip mila maiario kier la ina mela mai miridaip mila kakanim ga Parasaiop. Ga mamarikmeng, “Memani ga tale alagiming me togo?”
Ga mepulo teip mila maiario kier ties gare ro, “Tinan ga puoieng titot, karuk kan a noba migana la ume ties gare iriro migana la ume ties.”
Are ratmat ga mepulo Parasaiop ties gare ro, “Atabo mivanaong gat, a?
Atabo ira gar pang teip mila uke ga Parasaiop, agimaming noba migana la naganong ira? Karuk kan!
Pa miriro gar ma teip ga magaulap la tale kan omait maimai, Morowa leba makirara ang!”
Nikodimo, iriro migana tinan la ula ai Iesu na arubu, irie a gar maiang Parasaiop, la ugama,
“Atabo maimai buong la tiesieng meba buabung agarit migana na ties? Karuk. Buptang ka lake ties ang, meba maset abira paga la akosarong!”
Pa mepulo teip mila uke ties ang gare ro, “Memani, atabo nunuo gat nunuo migana onim Galili, a? Ovasnang maset babam ula puaru, meba onera. Karuk kan a noba unuli leba betang na provins Galili.” [
Mirier teip ga magaulap ganam la mela tapmat na luguap maiam na tara la nor la o aganuliap.]
